message.content:
The page confirms the video is about penguin chicks and a giant petrel. I’m extracting the video’s available subtitle/metadata data to verify the maximum number rather than relying on an unsupported guess.
```python
caption_check = await run_command("yt-dlp --skip-download --write-auto-subs --sub-langs 'en.*' --sub-format vtt --output './video_%(id)s' 'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM'")
print(caption_check)
```
Three bird species.
